name: Blackberry Pie
subtitle: A buttery pastry pie filled with sweet, thickened blackberries.
description: Make a soft cheese pastry, fill it with lightly sweetened blackberries, and bake until the crust is golden and the center is fully set.

ingredients.item: butter plus extra for the tin
self-raising flour plus extra for dusting
granulated sugar plus extra for the topping
cold butter cut into small pieces

instructions.text: Rub or cut the cold butter into the self-raising flour and granulated sugar until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add the soft cheese and knead briefly to form a dough.
Wrap the dough and chill for 60 minutes.
Toss the blackberries with the granulated sugar and 2 tablespoons cornflour until evenly coated.
Grease a pie tin with the butter and dust it with flour. Divide the chilled dough, roll out enough to line the tin, and press it into place.
Fill the pastry with the blackberry mixture. Roll out the remaining dough, cut it as needed, and arrange it over the filling. Seal the edges and trim away excess pastry.
Whisk the beaten egg with the milk, then brush it over the pastry. Sprinkle with the extra topping sugar.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden, the filling is bubbling, and the center is firm and fully set. For the egg-containing preparation, verify 160°F with a food thermometer.
Cool briefly before serving, with vanilla ice cream if desired.
